Coram : R.V. RAVEENDRAN*, H.L. DATTU
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996: ss. 7 and 2(h) - Party to arbitration agreement - Company entering into contract before the date on which it was entitled to commence business - On dispute invoking arbitration clause of the contract - Held: Since the company D date of contract, there was no contract - Consequently there was no arbitration agreement - The agreement would have been valid, if the contract were entered into by the promoters of the non-existing company on its behalf - Companies Act, 1956 - s. 149 (4) - Specific Relief E Act, 1963 - s. 15(h).
Decision Date : 20-04-2010 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3272/2007 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
